watches.name: TYPE 20 70 ANS
watches.description: A modern tribute to one of the most iconic military chronographs ever created. Featuring the legendary flyback chronograph, a Horizon Blue dial inspired by early 20th-century French design, and a transparent caseback revealing the Swiss Made column-wheel flyback chronograph movement within. The initial batch of the TYPE 20 70 ANS has now sold out , a testament to the enduring appeal of Airain’s aviation heritage. This anniversary edition celebrates 70 years of craftsmanship, precision, and timeless design. Deliveries of the first production batch are now underway. A new batch is coming soon, offering another opportunity to own this special anniversary edition. watches.name: TYPE 20 FURTIVITÉ
watches.description: The Type 20 Furtivité Limited Edition is a testament to stealthiness. Its name was chosen to emphasise its military overtones and its exclusive and elusive character. The anthracite shade provided by its Diamond-Like Carbon (DLC) coating offers enhanced durability and lends it a sleek, inconspicuous identity that subtly complements any outfit. Limited to 134 pieces. THE STORY Type 20 refers to a specification for pilot’s chronographs issued by the French Ministry of Defense. The unique feature of the Type 20 was the ‘flyback’ function, which allows the pilot to easily reset the chronograph hand, and quickly start timing a new event without the lag in time of pushing two more buttons. Other characteristics of the original Type 20 chronographs were: a 38mm diameter case, a black dial with luminescent indexes and hands, a hand-wound mechanical movement with a power reserve of over 35 hours, a relative precision of + or – 8 seconds per day and finally, the capacity to withstand the running, stopping and resetting of the chronograph more than 300 times without causing any problems to the movement. The Type 20 Furtivité Limited Edition is a testament to stealthiness. Its name was chosen to emphasise its military overtones and its exclusive and elusive character. The anthracite shade provided by its Diamond-Like Carbon (DLC) coating offers enhanced durability and lends it a sleek, inconspicuous identity that subtly complements any outfit. The Type 20 Furtivité is limited to 134 pieces and is powered by our caliber AM2, developed and made by Manufacture AMT – Sellita’s customisation department for high-end movements – in La Chaux-de-Fonds, Switzerland. watches.name: TYPE 21
watches.description: The Airain Type 21 is inspired by a 1960s vintage model first found at a Sotheby’s auction, which honored the French Ministry of Defence’s 1956 request to upgrade the Type 20 for increased durability and easier maintenance. Both the Type 21 and its predecessor feature a hand-wound column wheel chronograph with a flyback function and countdown bezel. The Type 21 sports a glossy black dial with Grade X1 ‘Old Radium’ lume, proudly showcasing the Airain crown logo and ‘Type 21’ marking. Its slightly larger stainless steel case retains the classic charm while meeting modern standards. Powered by the caliber AM2 from Manufacture AMT in La Chaux-de-Fonds, Switzerland, the Type 21 Re-Edition embodies timeless sophistication and functionality. THE STORY The Airain Type 21 stands as a tribute to a 1960s vintage model unearthed at a Sotheby’s auction in 2021. Rooted in the original 1950s designs, both the Type 21 and its sibling, the Type 20, faithfully embody the era’s aesthetics and functionalities. They feature a hand-wound column wheel chronograph with a flyback function and a countdown bezel. Interestingly, the Type 21 emerged from a French Ministry of Defence request in 1956, seeking an upgraded version of the Type 20 with enhanced durability and reduced maintenance requirements. Displaying a sleek black dial with Grade X1 ‘Old Radium’ lume, the Type 21 proudly bears the Airain crown logo and the distinct ‘Type 21’ marking. Notably, its bezel boasts a luminous triangle at the 12 o’clock mark. While the stainless steel case measures 39.0mm (bezel 39.5mm) — slightly larger than the original — it maintains the classic allure while meeting contemporary standards. The Type 21 Re-Edition is powered by the caliber AM2, meticulously crafted by Manufacture AMT, Sellita’s high-end division in La Chaux-de-Fonds, Switzerland. watches.name: TYPE 20
watches.description: The Type 20 stays true to every aspect of the original 1950’s Type 20, including a hand-wound column wheel chronograph with flyback function and countdown bezel, housed within a stainless steel case. Its black dial is paired elegantly with a cognac strap. THE STORY The Type 20 designation symbolizes a specific set of criteria for pilot’s chronographs mandated by the French Ministry of Defense. A standout feature of the Type 20 was its ‘flyback’ function, enabling pilots to swiftly reset the chronograph hand, facilitating quick initiation of a new timing event without the delay caused by pressing additional buttons. Original Type 20 chronographs boasted distinct features: a 38mm diameter case, a black dial with luminescent indexes and hands, a hand-wound mechanical chronograph movement with flyback complication offering over 35 hours of power reserve, a relative precision within + or – 8 seconds per day, and robustness capable of enduring over 300 chronograph resets without impacting the movement’s functionality. The new Airain Type 20 faithfully adheres to the precise design and specifications of the original 1950s Type 20. This re-edition incorporates a hand-wound column wheel chronograph with a flyback function and a countdown bezel. Its black dial, shielded by a domed sapphire crystal, mirrors the Arabic numerals seen on the original 1950s Type 20, featuring twin registers at 3 and 9 o’clock that can time up to 30 minutes. Carefully chosen hand-applied Super-LumiNova recreates the luminescent essence of the original Type 20. With a 39.0mm stainless steel case (39.5mm bezel) slightly larger than the original, it meets contemporary standards without losing the charm of its iconic predecessor. The Type 20 draws power from our caliber AM2, meticulously crafted by Manufacture AMT in La Chaux-de-Fonds, Switzerland—the custom division of Sellita known for high-end movement enhancements.
